WARNINGS

Observe the following instructions when working on the front door assembly:

  • When working on the hinges, take care not to damage the paintwork.
  • If a door adjustment requires the hinges to be moved, remove the door and touch up the paintwork in the hinge area.
  • If the weather strip is removed, even partially, it must always be replaced, even if undamaged. The adhesive does not guarantee a seal once removed from the body panel.
  • Use care when working on trim components and use the specified tools correctly in order to avoid damage.

PRECAUTIONS

Before working on the electrical system (connectors, electrical components, wiring etc.), turn the ignition off and disconnect the battery.
